mapper.select: SELECT lbl.request_id AS request_id ,lbl.status_code AS status_code ,lbl.request_user_id as user_id ,lbl.pop_up_alarm_flag ,lbl.user_check_flag ,to_char(lbl.actual_start_date, 'HH24:MI') AS request_date FROM lgcom_batch_log lbl WHERE lbl.actual_start_date > SYSDATE - 3 AND lbl.schedule_flag = 'N' AND lbl.pop_up_alarm_flag = 'N' AND lbl.user_check_flag = 'N'

SELECT /* concurrent.retrieveUnReadNotificationCandidates */ request_id AS REQUEST_ID, TO_CHAR(lbl.creation_date, 'MM:DD HH24:MI') AS REQUEST_DATE, program_name FROM lgcom_batch_log lbl, lgcom_program_m lpm WHERE lbl.POP_UP_ALARM_FLAG = 'Y' AND lbl.user_check_flag = 'N' AND lbl.schedule_flag = 'N' and lbl.program_id = lpm.program_id and lpm.program_type_code = 'BATCH' AND actual_start_date > SYSDATE - 3 AND request_user_id = #{USER_SESSION.applicationUserId}

SELECT /* concurrent.retrieveUnReadNotificationCandidates */ request_id AS REQUEST_ID, TO_CHAR(lbl.creation_date, 'MM:DD HH24:MI') AS REQUEST_DATE, program_name FROM lgcom_batch_log lbl, lgcom_program_m lpm WHERE lbl.POP_UP_ALARM_FLAG = 'N' AND lbl.user_check_flag = 'N' AND lbl.schedule_flag = 'N' and lbl.program_id = lpm.program_id and lpm.program_type_code = 'BATCH' AND actual_start_date > SYSDATE - 3 AND request_user_id = #{USER_SESSION.applicationUserId}
mapper.update: UPDATE /* concurrent.updateBatchPopupAlarmFlag */ LGCOM_BATCH_LOG SET POP_UP_ALARM_FLAG = 'Y', last_updated_by = #{USER_SESSION.applicationUserId}, last_update_date = SYSDATE WHERE request_id = #{requestId}
